patch_description: Reorder the twelve CRZ entangling gates into two qubit-disjoint-friendly sublayers (Sublayer A: [0,2],[1,3],[2,4],[3,5],[5,7]; Sublayer B: [0,3],[0,7],[0,8],[1,8],[2,6],[4,8],[6,7]) while keeping the exact same gates, wires, and shared parameter names. This groups gates that touch disjoint qubits (or logically related qubit-0 rotations) so any greedy/list-order-based depth scheduler in the backend can pack more operations concurrently, aiming to reduce circuit depth (target ~39 from 41) without changing gate_count (207) or n_params (162). Since only the order changes and no gates/params are added or removed, this is a low-risk structural edit that can only help or be neutral for expressivity while potentially improving depth-related efficiency metrics and training speed.
